pages.title: Want to wear hanbok in Gamcheon Culture Village?
pages.body: If Gamcheon is on your BTS route, a hanbok rental shop in the village lets you take photos in traditional dress. Compare time slots, what is included and cancellation terms before booking, and allow extra time — the village lanes are steep.
pages.button: See Gamcheon hanbok rental on Klook ↗

pages.title: Staying in Haeundae or Suyeong?
pages.body: This shared shuttle serves eligible hotels whose English address lists Haeundae-gu or Suyeong-gu. Choose a pickup at least 2 hours after your flight arrival, and check the hotel list and luggage limit (one 26-inch suitcase plus one small carry-on per passenger) before booking.
pages.button: Check the Haeundae airport shuttle on Klook ↗

pages.title: Prefer a direct ride to your Seomyeon hotel?
pages.body: Compare available airport-transfer vehicles for your party and luggage. Check the exact hotel address, passenger and suitcase capacity, pickup instructions, final price and any late-hour surcharge on the booking page.
pages.button: Compare airport transfer options on Klook ↗

pages.title: Landing late or travelling with several bags?
pages.body: Check whether a pre-booked vehicle is available for your arrival time. Compare passenger and luggage capacity, the exact pickup arrangement, the final quote and any late-hour surcharge before paying; availability is not guaranteed for every time.

pages.title: Want mobile data as soon as you arrive?
pages.body: This Klook Korea eSIM is data-only and does not include a Korean phone number. Check that your phone supports eSIM and is not carrier-locked before buying. Review the available data plan and activation terms for your travel dates.
pages.button: Compare Korea eSIM plans on Klook ↗

pages.before: 4. Pair Taejongdae with one nearby stop
pages.title: Would you rather not manage the shuttle and hills yourself?
pages.body: If the free shuttle queue, the walking and the transfers feel like too much for one day, a guided Busan highlights day tour that stops at Taejongdae is an alternative. It covers the lighthouse and observation area as one stop among several, not a full Taejongdae visit. Check the itinerary, meeting point, language and cancellation terms before booking.
pages.button: See the Busan highlights day tour on Klook ↗

pages.title: Arriving late or with heavy bags?
pages.body: A pre-booked airport transfer fixes the price before you land, so there is no meter or late-night surcharge to watch. Compare the vehicle size, luggage allowance, pickup point and final quote; availability depends on your arrival time.
